description: Find supermarket products in the European price registry by name (any language), brand or barcode. One typing mistake is forgiven. Returns product ids to use with get_product, compare_basket and proof. Optionally limited to one country and one category. Costs 1 credit (0.002 USDC with x402).

category.description: Category key such as "dairy-eggs" (see price_index for the keys in use).

country.description: ISO-2 country code in lower case (al, at, ba, be, bg, ch, cy, cz, de, dk, ee, es, fi, fr, gb, gr, hr, hu, ie, is, it, lt, lu, lv, mt, nl, pl, pt, ro, rs, se, si, sk, tr)

query.description: A product name in any language, a brand, or a barcode (8–14 digits), e.g. "kiselo mlyako 3.6%" or "5998200464959".

name: search_products
title: Search products
